developer_mode.title: Turn on Developer mode
developer_mode.body: In ChatGPT, open **Settings → Security and login** and switch on **Developer mode**.

plugin.title: Add Memex as a plugin
plugin.body: Open [Plugins](https://chatgpt.com/plugins) and choose **+ (Add) → Create MCP App**. Name it **Memex**, paste this address, tick the confirmation box and click **Create**.

approve.title: Allow the connection
approve.body: Memex opens in a new tab. Click **Connect it**.

chatgpt.permissions: To stop ChatGPT asking each time, open **Settings → Plugins → Memex** and choose **Allow all actions**.

add.title: Add your memex
add.body: In Claude, open **Settings → Connectors** and click **Add**. Name it **Memex**, paste this address and click **Continue**. Keep the detected settings, then click **Add**.
add.tip: Free accounts can have one custom connector.

approve.title: Connect and approve
approve.body: Click **Connect** next to Memex in Claude. When Memex opens, click **Connect it**.

claude.permissions: To stop Claude asking each time, open **Memex** in **Connectors** and choose **Always allow** for both **Read-only tools** and **Write/delete tools**.

persist_note.before: For future chats, also paste this into

custom_apps.title: Find Custom apps for Spark
custom_apps.body: In Gemini, open **Settings → Personal intelligence → Connected Apps** and find **Custom apps for Spark**.
custom_apps.tip: Spark requires a paid Google AI Pro or Ultra plan.

link.title: Add the Memex link
link.body: Under **Custom apps for Spark**, paste this address and click **Next**. On the next screen, leave the settings as they are and click **Next** again.

accounts.title: Link your accounts
accounts.body: Check the confirmation box and click **Connect**. When Google asks to link your Google and Memex accounts, click **Agree and continue**. When Memex opens, click **Connect it**.

save.title: Save your custom app
save.body: Keep the name **Memex** and click **Connect** to save it, then switch to Spark.
